verdict.rationale: Gitea is a free, self-hosted Git service offering "full control" [gitea-docs-30]. It deploys on whatever servers and databases you choose [gitea-docs-9, gitea-docs-23, gitea-docs-14], so the user decides where data physically lives. The managed offering explicitly lets you "Choose your provider and region" [gitea-docs-32]. Community reports corroborate data placement, describing deployments on a personal VPS and on a USB stick [gitea-comm-3, gitea-comm-12]. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of which regions the managed service offers, and any formal data-residency guarantees for it.
